method.pack: bun pm pack --ignore-scripts from a scratch package containing the verified dist and the matching source bin, patches, vendor, package.json, README and license

method.readiness: Wait for the launcher URL banner before GET / returns 200 and the durable retention report exists.
method.stop: SIGINT to the recorded launcher handle, await exit and owned runner cleanup; count every line through shutdown.

journalBlockingWaitProbe.procedure: In two isolated processes, use the production recordBlockingWait with a 300 ms synchronous state-write-lock sample, once per process owner. The CLI journal-mode tests independently verify propagation to both children.
journalBlockingWaitProbe.quietProbe: The same two probes with LLV_QUIET_DIAGNOSTICS=1 exit 0, print zero bytes, and each retains one measurement in blockingWaitDiagnostics().

verificationHistory.cause: Generated process and request UUIDs were classified as resource identifiers; evidence now uses neutral labels.

earlierFailures: Earlier runs exited 1 on intermittent fixture startup timeouts before either child started. The same early-startup failure reproduced against base production source. The test now waits for its existing Viewer-start marker before probing, avoiding a connection accepted by the CLI temporary port-availability listener. The base-full-with-regressions run also intentionally exercised the new behavior assertions against old production source and exited 1.
selfUpdateCause: Fresh installs have no downloaded-release cache. realpath of the absent release root raised ENOENT and became the summary error. An absent cache is now empty; a file or dangling alias still reports its cause even in quiet mode.
scope: Diagnostic output and the package banner only; measurements remain available. The separate bounded-volume policy is unchanged. No performance improvement is claimed.

mainRecheck.changes: Scanner and pipeline-controller files advanced during verification; none overlap the changed files.

proposedAdjustment.test: Extend the existing runtimeDiagnostics fixture in bin/cli.exposure.integration.test.ts with transaction-hold reports from both roles; ordinary output must omit them and journal/debug output must retain them.

cloudRun88Refresh.rawCampaignNote: The campaign retains its initial typecheck heap failure. The subsequent clean-source typecheck is the final verdict for the tracked source tree.
cloudRun88Refresh.runtime: Bun 1.4.0; Codex 0.162.1 for the native fixture
cloudRun88Refresh.method: One gate-slot admission. Each explicit test file runs alone with setsid --wait and stdin closed. checkEnvironment and isolatedEnvironment provide private HOME, XDG config/cache/data, state and temp roots; exposure fixtures also get a private runtime directory with no host user bus. Typecheck uses a separate fresh source export and a 6 GB Node heap; package builds retain their own caches. Both first runs use env -i, telemetry disabled, a free port and --no-open, observe 65 seconds after HTTP readiness and the retention report, then send SIGINT and verify all recorded child identities have exited.
cloudRun88Refresh.terminalNormalization: All lines are retained. Private roots use neutral placeholders and generated UUIDs use resource labels.

cloudRun88Refresh.harnessNotes: An early source check lost the wrapper heap option. Full typecheck after package builds also included generated Next route types and reached the heap limit; the final source check uses a clean export. An early exact-output fixture inherited the real gate service user bus and printed its OOM-policy warning; final exposure checks isolate that transport. Initial listener-startup fixture failures reproduced on main. No source change was made to work around those observations.
cloudRun88Refresh.reportText:
Applied Codex Cloud run 88 unchanged in the five requested source files and merged the 1.16.0 main update. Final isolated runs printed 148 lines on main and 8 on the branch, with retention errors reduced from one to zero. Both launchers exited cleanly with no recorded children left running.

All 11 branch test files and all 9 files present on main passed: 316 branch tests and 312 main tests, with 29 and 29 existing skips. Fresh-source typecheck and ESLint passed. Every terminal line and earlier check outcome is retained in `evidence/clean-package-startup.json`.

One timing diagnostic still escapes: `[state transaction-hold]`, reporting a transaction hold of 103 ms. Its producer is `src/lib/state/sqliteStateStore.ts:581`; the Cloud filter at `bin/cli.mjs:209` handles only loop-gap and performance-summary prefixes. Extending that filter and the existing exposure fixture would depart from the instruction to apply the Cloud diff unchanged. Should the filter gain this prefix and its regression case (recommended), or should the exact Cloud patch remain with this limitation? The proposed hunk is recorded with the evidence.

transactionHoldFollowup.approvedAdjustment: Extend only the launcher timing-prefix filter and existing exposure fixture for state transaction-hold. The other Cloud source files retain the run-88 blobs.
transactionHoldFollowup.method: One gate-slot admission, sequential explicit test files, typecheck, ESLint, regression mutation, package builds, packs, isolated global installs and first runs. Tests use checkEnvironment and isolatedEnvironment with private HOME, XDG directories, LLV_STATE_DIR and TMPDIR. Temp directories use an open procfs directory alias into the private scratch area to keep fixture socket names within the Unix limit. Typecheck uses a clean source export, separate from both package-build exports, with a 6 GB Node heap. Packages are built with node scripts/prepack.mjs, packed with bun pm pack --ignore-scripts and installed with bun add -g --ignore-scripts --backend=copyfile. First runs use env -i, a free port, --no-open, telemetry disabled and a closed control URL; observe 65 seconds after HTTP readiness and the retention report, then send SIGINT and check recorded process identities.
transactionHoldFollowup.terminalNormalization: Every line is retained; private scratch roots use neutral placeholders and generated UUIDs use stable resource labels.

transactionHoldFollowup.reportText:
A fresh package start now prints 7 terminal lines, compared with 147 on the merged main revision. Startup progress, loop-gap, performance summaries and transaction-hold timing reports stay out of ordinary output. Debug and service journal output retain diagnostics, and real errors still reach the terminal.

The self-update error came from treating a release-cache directory that does not exist yet as a failure. A missing cache is now empty; invalid roots still report errors. Codex Cloud run 88 supplied the original fix. The approved follow-up adds the transaction-hold filter and its regression case; the other Cloud files remain unchanged.

All 11 branch test files passed (316 tests; 29 existing skips). Typecheck and ESLint passed. Removing the added filter makes both ordinary-output regression cases fail; all three journal/debug cases still pass. Both clean first runs exited successfully with no recorded children left running. Every terminal line and the earlier main test comparison are in evidence/clean-package-startup.json. Committed with hooks enabled; nothing pushed.
